customSql.name: Order Totals (Custom SQL)
customSql.sqlQuery:
SELECT id_sales_order, cart_note, currency_iso_code, customer_reference, email, first_name, last_name, order_reference, price_mode, salutation, store, spy_sales_order.created_at, spy_sales_order.updated_at, canceled_total, discount_total, grand_total, merchant_commission_refunded_total, merchant_commission_total, order_expense_total, refund_total, subtotal, tax_total
       FROM spy_sales_order
         LEFT JOIN spy_sales_order_totals ON spy_sales_order.id_sales_order = spy_sales_order_totals.fk_sales_order
WHERE spy_sales_order_totals.id_sales_order_totals =
      (SELECT spy_sales_order_totals.id_sales_order_totals
       FROM spy_sales_order_totals
       WHERE fk_sales_order = spy_sales_order.id_sales_order
       ORDER BY spy_sales_order.created_at DESC, id_sales_order_totals DESC
       LIMIT 1)
